job.title: Chemistry Teacher
job.description:
A leading independent school in London requires a permanent Chemistry from January 2027. 

Essential: Prior experience teaching Chemistry at KS5 or applications from strong ECTs or postgraduates would also be warmly considered. Full support would be provided for the ECT Induction.

Desired: Experience teaching A level Chemistry and a background in the independent sector would be a bonus; however, this is certainly not essential.

The school is set on picturesque grounds and offers state of the art facilities. Academic rigour underpinned by excellent pastoral care is at the forefront of the school's mission. If you are a passionate about Chemistry and would like the opportunity to teach in a top school, please forward your CV asap by clicking the 'Apply' button.

job.title: Teacher of Latin & Classical Civilisation
job.description:
A leading independent school in London requires a teacher of Latin and Classical Civilisation from January, 2027. The post would entail teaching both Latin and Classical Civilisation to A level.
 
Essential:  Prior experience teaching Latin and Classical Civilisation at KS5, or applications from strong ECTs or postgraduates would also be warmly considered. Full support would be provided for the ECT Induction.
 
Desired: Experience teaching Latin and/or Classical Civilisation at A level and a background in the independent sector would be a bonus; however, this is not essential.    

The successful candidate will be able to convey their enthusiasm and commitment to students of all ages and to encourage self-motivation and  a genuine love of learning and enquiry. Steeped in tradition, the school places an equal emphasis on academic excellence and a robust pastoral care system. The school are looking to appoint an inspirational teacher who is able to engage pupils through creative yet stimulating lessons. Being able to offer inspirational teaching is central to the school's ethos. 


If you are passionate about the classical world and who would like the opportunity to teach in a top school, please forward your CV as soon as possible by clicking the 'Apply' button.

Harris Hill is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and expect all partners to share this commitment.
